crossRefs.note: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at…
As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

people.name: Abiram
people.line: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron

people.name: Dathan
people.line: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

translations.web: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
translations.bsb: So they moved away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Meanwhile, Dathan and Abiram had come out and stood at the entrances to their tents with their wives and children and infants.
translations.kjv: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
translations.asv: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.
